name: Puerto Rico Cubing Open 2026

venue.name: Casa de Ajedrez
venue.details: Once inside the Casa de Ajedrez, walk past the reception desk to the hall that is to your right. The room will be the first door to the left in that hallway (big glass wall).

information:
¡Con la ayuda de Puerto Rico Speedcubers (PRSC) y Cubing Frontiers LLC, estamos felices de anunciar la quinta competencia oficial de Cubing en Puerto Rico!
With the help of the Puerto Rico Speedcubers (PRSC) and Cubing Frontiers LLC, we are happy to announce the fifth official Cubing Competition in Puerto Rico!
